digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate; ticket lifecycle orchestration; CLI registry; config composition; binding store reconciliation
propositions: Five recovered approved-but-lossy recovery proposals (RP-02 through RP-06) from 2026-08-16 janitor plan must be mapped to decision-ready briefs covering architectural intent, hard-won behavior, invariants, edge cases, implementation seams, migration hazards, and remaining maintainer choices before becoming implementation stories.
RP-02 requires clarification of fail-closed transaction semantics for binding-store retirement: narrow journal-free exact-overlap option versus structural parity or versioned journal.

RP-03 lifecycle protocol must resolve three components: scoped breaker rule per-operation-scope behavior, label-first bounded containment after Jira create succeeds with key-persistence failure, and explicit dependency ordering with one-story design.

RP-04 config composition and ownership precedence (explicit > environment > project > user > default) must be named explicitly, including CLI-over-environment correction and removal of Cloud's DIG adapter fallback.
RP-05 CLI registry and public-help policy must decide: normalize all 21 advanced verbs to side-effect-free package-data help immediately or preserve current two-family help policy.

RP-06 plan-review policy routing must reverse the 761e unconditional exactly-once Round-A fan-in, apply activated project criteria against effective applicability, and resolve parity-first versus blocking-capable normalization of current-run failure projection; failed/cancelled checkpoints must never become success markers.
